```artifact
Feature: System Availability and User Management

  Scenario: System Availability by Pin Code
    Given the system is configured with pin codes "1234" and "5678"
    When the user attempts to access the system with pin code "1234"
    Then the system is available
    And the system displays the login page

  Scenario: System Unavailability by Pin Code
    Given the system is configured with pin codes "1234" and "5678"
    When the user attempts to access the system with pin code "invalid_pin"
    Then the system is unavailable
    And the system displays an error message "Invalid pin code"

  Scenario: User Login
    Given the system is configured with pin codes "1234" and "5678"
    And the user has a valid username "valid_user" and password "valid_password"
    When the user attempts to login with username "valid_user" and password "valid_password"
    Then the user is logged in
    And the system displays the dashboard

  Scenario: Invalid User Login
    Given the system is configured with pin codes "1234" and "5678"
    And the user has an invalid username "invalid_user" and password "valid_password"
    When the user attempts to login with username "invalid_user" and password "valid_password"
    Then the user is not logged in
    And the system displays an error message "Invalid username or password"

  Scenario: Doctor-Specialty Mapping
    Given the system is configured with pin codes "1234" and "5678"
    And there are two doctors with specialty "Cardiology" and "Dermatology"
    When the user attempts to map a doctor to a specialty
    Then the doctor is mapped to one and only one specialty
    And the system displays a success message "Doctor specialty mapping successful"

  Scenario: Patient Registration
    Given the system is configured with pin codes "1234" and "5678"
    And there is a patient with unique ID "patient_1"
    When the patient attempts to register
    Then the patient is registered
    And the system generates a unique ID for the patient
    And the system displays a success message "Patient registration successful"

  Scenario: Consultation Request
    Given the system is configured with pin codes "1234" and "5678"
    And there is a patient with unique ID "patient_1" and a doctor with specialty "Cardiology"
    When the patient attempts to request a consultation
    Then the patient is able to request a consultation
    And the system displays a success message "Consultation request successful"

  Scenario Outline: Pin Code Length and Format
    Given the system is configured with pin codes "1234" and "5678"
    When the user attempts to access the system with pin code "<pin_code>"
    Then the system is available
    Examples:
      | pin_code |
      | 1234     |
      | 5678     |
      | 12345    |
      | abcdef   |

  Scenario Outline: Secure Handling of Credentials
    Given the system is configured with pin codes "1234" and "5678"
    And the user has a valid username "valid_user" and password "valid_password"
    When the user attempts to login with username "valid_user" and password "valid_password"
    Then the user is logged in
    And the system stores the password encrypted
    Examples:
      | username | password |
      | valid_user | valid_password |
      | invalid_user | invalid_password |

  Scenario Outline: Unique Patient ID
    Given the system is configured with pin codes "1234" and "5678"
    When the patient attempts to register
    Then the system generates a unique ID for the patient
    And the system does not reuse the patient ID
    Examples:
      | patient_id |
      | patient_1  |
      | patient_2  |
      | patient_3  |
```
